CategoryDesc: Standards and technologies to identify and track items, automatic identification and data collection.

FilterItems.Name: AIAG
FilterItems.Description: Automotive Industry Action Group is a not-for-profit organization where companies in the mobility industries have worked collaboratively to drive down cost and complexity in the supply chain.

FilterItems.Name: B-3 AIAG
FilterItems.Description: B3 sipping/parts identification label standard. Automotive Industry Action Group is a not-for-profit organization where companies in the mobility industries have worked collaboratively to drive down cost and complexity in the supply chain.

FilterItems.Name: CLEI
FilterItems.Description: Common Language Equipment Identifier (Industry Standard globally unique identifier for telecom equipment). CLEI codes must be acquired by telecommunications equipment manufacturers and assigned to devices before they are sold to a licensed service provider.

FilterItems.Name: Code 128
FilterItems.Tip: Barcode 128 Standard, supports all 128 ASCII code characters
FilterItems.Description: High density 1D barcode format used commonly for certain shipping labels, primarily as defined by GS1 in the GS1-128barcode standard. Code 128 was invented to solve the problem of representing both alphabetic and numeric characters without sacrificing barcode density. Code 128 enables you to encode all 128 ASCII characters, as Code 39 - Full ASCII does. Additionally, when you encode only numbers, Code 128 can encode them more densely than Interleaved 2 of 5 does.

FilterItems.Name: Code 39
FilterItems.Tip: Barcode 39 Standard, supports numbers, letters, and some symbols.
FilterItems.Description: Older 1D BarCode type symbology using alphabetic characters and numeric digits

FilterItems.Name: Data Matrix
FilterItems.Tip: Barcode Standard using datamatrix of black and white cells
FilterItems.Description: 2D barcode type, variable-size matrixsymbology that can support several different character sets, using up to 2,335 characters in any language.

FilterItems.Name: DLOC
FilterItems.Description: Data field for a container label that indicates delivery location.

FilterItems.Name: DoD
FilterItems.Description: Department of Defense

FilterItems.Name: DUNS
FilterItems.Description: Data Universal Numbering System is a unique, nine-digit series of numerals that identifies a business.

FilterItems.Name: EPC
FilterItems.Description: The Electronic Product Code is syntax for unique identifiers assigned to physical objects, unit loads, locations, or other identifiable entity playing a role in business operations

FilterItems.Name: GDTI
FilterItems.Description: Global Document Type Identifier

FilterItems.Name: GM
FilterItems.Description: General Motors, Shipping and part tracking labels

FilterItems.Name: GS1
FilterItems.Description: Global Standards 1. Standards committee for supply chain tracking. GS1 is a global, not-for-profit association that maintains standards for barcodes and RFID tags and for supply chain messaging such as Electronic Data Interchange (EDI).

FilterItems.Name: GS1-128
FilterItems.Description: Application of GSI standard using Code 128 barcode. GS1-128(also called UCC-128, EAN-128, and UCC/EAN-128) is a variant of Code 128 that conforms to GS1 specifications.

FilterItems.Name: GSRN
FilterItems.Description: Global Service Relation Number identifies the relationships of service organizations to service providers (such as doctors who work for a hospital) and to service recipients (such as members of frequent flyer or retailer loyalty programs).

FilterItems.Name: GTIN
FilterItems.Description: Global Trade Item Number identifies products, inner packs, cases, and pallets at the point of sale or in a distribution or warehouse environment.

FilterItems.Name: GTL
FilterItems.Description: Global Trade Item Number identifies products, inner packs, cases, and pallets at the point of sale or in a distribution or warehouse environment.

FilterItems.Name: HIBC
FilterItems.Tip: Health Industry Business Communications bar codes
FilterItems.Description: Health Industry Business Communications Bar Code (BarCode information requirements for Healthcare supply chain) was created to track medical and pharmaceutical products via bar codes.

FilterItems.Name: I-Trace
FilterItems.Tip: GS1 standard railway barcodes with shipment tracing
FilterItems.Description: GS1 standard railway barcodes with shipment tracing

FilterItems.Name: Interleaved 2-of-5
FilterItems.Description: 1D barcode format for digits is a member of the Code 2 of 5 symbology family. It is sometimes referred to as ITF and forms the basis for the ITF-14 symbology that is widely used for shipping and transport logistics.

FilterItems.Name: ISO
FilterItems.Description: International Organization for Standardization is a private international organization that develops voluntary international standards that have been adopted by all major industries worldwide. The organization develops and publishes standardization in all technical and nontechnical fields other than electrical and electronic engineering.

FilterItems.Name: Magnetic Stripe
FilterItems.Description: Magnetic data storage. Popularly used on credit cards. Magnetic stripe cards are commonly used in credit cards, identity cards, and transportation tickets. They may also contain an RFID tag, a transponder device and/or a microchip mostly used for business premises access control or electronic payment.

FilterItems.Name: MicroPDF417
FilterItems.Description: wo-dimensional, variable-length Stacked linear barcode format symbology that is designed to encode a moderate amount of data in a very small space. It is based on PDF417 and shares several of its features.

FilterItems.Name: Mil-STD
FilterItems.Description: The standard for container and shipment labeling of military equipment and supplies. Mil-Std-129 Revision R introduced significant changes to labeling requirements.

FilterItems.Name: PDF417
FilterItems.Description: PDF417 is a two-dimensional, variable-length stacked symbology that was developed in 1992 to encode large amounts of data in a small area. Its name derives from its format: a portable data file (PDF) that carries four bar elements and four space elements arranged in a 17-module codeword. It is used in a variety of settings: Government-issued identification cards (such as driver's licenses), airline boarding passes, postage stamps, and package labels, etc.

FilterItems.Name: POSTNET
FilterItems.Description: Postal Numeric Encoding Technique (machine readable encoding of ZipCode) symbology was developed by the United States Postal Service (USPS) to help sort business reply and courtesy reply mail and was also used for regular bulk mailings. It was typically used in conjunction with the USPS Postal Alpha Numeric Encoding Technique (USPS PLANET) symbology.

FilterItems.Name: PPE
FilterItems.Description: Personal protective equipment (PPE) refers to protective clothing, helmets, gloves, face shields, goggles, facemasks and/or respirators or other equipment designed to protect the wearer from injury or the spread of infection or illness.

FilterItems.Name: QR Code
FilterItems.Description: 2D barcode type general-purpose matrix barcodethat is intended for use on smaller labels. It was designed for faster scanning of information, and it efficiently encodes kanji characters.

FilterItems.Name: RAIN
FilterItems.Description: Acronym derived from Radio frequency identification is intended as a nod to the link between UHF RFID and the cloud, where RFID-based data can be stored, managed and shared via the Internet. A RAIN RFID solution uses a reader to read and write a tagged item, manage the data and take action. RAIN RFID is Passive UHF RFID that has been certified by the RAIN Alliance.

FilterItems.Name: RFID
FilterItems.Description: Radio-frequency Identification uses electromagnetic fields to automatically identify and track tags attached to objects.

FilterItems.Name: SP20
FilterItems.Description: Standards Practice 20  - Required shipping label format required by Caterpillar.

FilterItems.Name: SSCC
FilterItems.Description: Serial Shipping Container Code is an 18-digit number used to identify logistics units. In order to automate the reading process, the SSCC is often encoded in a barcode, generally GS1-128, and can also be encoded in an RFIDtag. It is used in electronic commerce transactions.

FilterItems.Name: Transparency
FilterItems.Description: Amazon Transparency, a system for authenticating products. The Transparency code is a unique alpha-numeric identifier for each unit of a product. This can be available in 2 formats. It can be a 26 digit, alpha-numeric identifier beginning with AZ: or ZA: (e.g. AZ:L1Z2H38F4C5Q6R7E5K6Z1C2K3E; total length is 29 characters). It can also be a Serialized Global Trade Item Number or SGTIN e.g. 0100376204200301214P1OZMT7D8B81EMF4WW4 ; total length is 38 characters

FilterItems.Name: UPC-A
FilterItems.Description: Universal Product Code (1D barcode type) was initially developed for use by the US grocery industry, and its use has spread into other retail marketplaces in the US and internationally.

FilterItems.Name: USPS
FilterItems.Description: United States Postal Service product and shipping labels

FilterItems.Name: Walmart
FilterItems.Description: Walmart shipping label requirements
